summary: Decodes image row data from an IDAT-chunk compressed stream held by the this object. Initializes buffer sizing when a flag is clear, then either performs a per-pass Huffman decode and returns, or reads/filters row data: guards row-read permission, refills IDAT chunks, inflates rows via sub_517ADC, verifies stream completion, copies pixel-format bytes, computes row geometry, unpacks and copies the row, runs optional post-processing, applies pass-aware horizontal stretch plus a2/a3 Huffman decode passes, finalizes via sub_519019, and invokes an optional callback stored at this+0x16C. Called by sub_511F23. Pass index (this+0x114) drives a 7-way switch of bitmask/threshold checks on (this+0xD4) and (this+0xB8).

Dispatch guard: when (this+0x113) is zero or (this+0x60) bit 1 is clear, skip the per-pass switch and go directly to the row-read path.

Switch on pass index (this+0x114). Each case tests bit masks of (this+0xD4) against per-pass thresholds of (this+0xB8) to decide whether to run an a3 Huffman decode pass then finalize via sub_519019, or fall through to the row-decode path.
case 0: if (this+0xD4) & 7 == 0, fall through to row decode; otherwise branch to the shared a3 decode-and-finalize path (LABEL_34).
case 1: if (this+0xD4) & 7 != 0 or (this+0xB8) < 5 (guard:0), optionally run JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a3, 15) then return sub_519019(this).
case 2: if (this+0xD4) & 7 == 4, fall through; if a3 is null return sub_519019(this); else run JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a3, 255) then return sub_519019(this).
case 3: if (this+0xD4) & 3 != 0 or (this+0xB8) < 3 (guard:1), optionally run JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a3, 51) then return sub_519019(this).
case 4: if (this+0xD4) & 3 == 2, fall through; if a3 is null return sub_519019(this); else run JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a3, 255) then return sub_519019(this).
case 5: if (this+0xD4) & 1 != 0 or (this+0xB8) < 2 (guard:2), optionally run JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a3, 85) then return sub_519019(this).
default: if (this+0x114) == 6 (guard:3) and (this+0xD4) & 1 == 0, return sub_519019(this); otherwise fall through to the row-read path.
Row-read entry guard: if (this+0x58) bit 2 is clear, raise fatal error via GuardedCallWithLongjmp(this, aInvalidAttempt).
Set output row pointer (this+0x70) = row buffer (this+0xDC).
Set rows remaining (this+0x74) = total row count (this+0xCC).
Decompression loop: while (this+0x68) is nonzero, inflate one row via sub_517ADC(this+0x64, 1); return value 1 means stream complete (exit loop), any other nonzero value means fatal error.

Chunk refill loop: while chunk length (this+0xFC) is zero, load the next chunk header: sub_518828(this, 0), CallbackDispatchWithNullGuard(this, &a1, 4), store ByteArrayToInt(&a1) into (this+0xFC), AnimationHandleAlloc(this), sub_517F58(this, this+0x10C, 4); if the 4-byte chunk type at this+0x10C is not 'IDAT' (aIdat), raise fatal 'Not enough image data' (aNotEnoughImage).

Refill active chunk: (this+0x68) = chunk data size (this+0xA0), current pointer (this+0x64) = base (this+0x9C), clamp (this+0x68) to remaining chunk length (this+0xFC), consume bytes via sub_517F58(this, base, count), and subtract the consumed amount from (this+0xFC).
On sub_517ADC error, load message pointer (this+0x7C); default to 'Decompression error' (aDecompressionE) when null; raise fatal GuardedCallWithLongjmp(this, message).
After a successful row inflate, if rows remaining (this+0x74) is zero, skip stream-completion verification and jump to post-row processing (LABEL_59).
Stream-completion verification: if rows remaining (this+0x74), bytes remaining (this+0x68), or chunk length (this+0xFC) are nonzero, raise fatal 'Extra compressed data' (aExtraCompresse).
Mark decompression complete: (this+0x58) |= 0x8 and (this+0x5C) |= 0x20.
Copy pixel-format bytes into output state: (this+0xF8) = (this+0x116), (this+0xF9) = (this+0x117), (this+0xFA) = (this+0x11A), (this+0xFB) = (this+0x119).
Compute row geometry: samples = (this+0xD0), bpp = (this+0x119); store (this+0xF0) = samples and (this+0xF4) = (samples * bpp + 7) >> 3.
Unpack/filter the decoded row: sub_518511(this, this+0xF0, rowbuf+1 where rowbuf=(this+0xDC), (this+0xD8)+1, filter-type byte at *(this+0xDC)).
Copy the processed row to the output buffer: MemoryCopy(this, row size (this+0xD8), row buffer (this+0xDC), bytes-per-row (this+0xC8) + 1).
If (this+0x60) is nonzero, run post-row processing sub_51389E(this).

Pass-aware post-decode (enabled when (this+0x113) is nonzero and (this+0x60) bit 1 set): when pass index (this+0x114) < 6, run TextureHorizontalStretch(this+0xF0, (this+0xDC)+1, (this+0x114)); then run JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a3, dword_5AF248[(this+0x114)]) and JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a2, dword_5AF22C[(this+0x114)]).
Fallback post-decode: run JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a2, 255) and JPEGHuffmanDecoder(this, a3, 255).
Finalize the decoded row / update state: sub_519019(this).
Load optional callback pointer (this+0x16C); if non-null, return callback(this, (this+0xD4), (this+0x114)); otherwise return null.
